user.title: Connect to your Sony receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver's IP address. Make sure it is powered on, and that Settings > Network > Network Standby is enabled so it stays reachable in standby.

pin.title: Enter the pairing PIN
pin.description: The receiver at {host} is showing a PIN on its display. Enter it here to finish pairing.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the receiver. Check the IP address and that it is powered on.
error.cannot_register: The receiver refused the pairing request.
error.invalid_auth: That PIN was not accepted. Try again.
error.pairing_mode_required: The receiver refused the pairing request. On the receiver, open Settings > Network > Device Registration, choose to add a device, then submit this form again.

abort.already_configured: This receiver is already set up.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw IRCC remote-control command to the receiver.

command.name: Command
command.description: Name of the IRCC command, for example 'home' or 'display'.
